text:
jordan: PTAL — addressed the serialization edge case you pointed out and added a small shim for legacy clients. Details:
- moved the fallback into serializer.go
- added unit + integration test that hits the shim path
- added a short smoke script and instructions below

jordan: PTAL (sorry for the larger diff than planned, tried to keep changes scoped) :wave:

maya: will take a look in ~30m, thanks for the clear summary :+1:

sasha: quick q — does the shim affect the hot path perf? any extra allocs at request time?

jordan: good call. the shim is only on deserialization failure so it's cold path; unit benches show negligible alloc impact. i added a note in the PR description under "performance".

anita: looks good from a correctness POV. i left one tiny nits comment about variable naming but not blocking.

jordan: addressed the var rename and pushed an amend, also added the smoke instructions to the PR body:
```
# smoke test (run from infra/tools)
./smoke_run.sh --env staging --config test/fixtures/legacy-client.json
# expect: 200 + no stack traces in logs
```

merge-bot: Canary slot reserved: 2023-11-18 15:30 UTC for PR #4129 (owner: unassigned)

maya: can we claim merge ownership? i'm available during that window and can shepherd the canary.

maya: also can someone run the quick perf harness against staging? sasha?

sasha: i can run the perf harness 10m before canary and post results. will run with the smoke fixture to simulate legacy client.

devops-bot: Smoke run completed: 0 errors, 6 warnings (config warnings). Logs: https://logs.internal/smoke/4129/20231118

devops-bot: Sampling of traces looks clean, no serialization panics found.

jordan: thanks — assigning merge ownership to @maya in the PR description. PTAL again if you want, otherwise maya can merge after successful canary. :thumbsup:

maya: LGTM from me once the small lint fix is applied (i can push the fix if someone prefers).

anita: approved (non-blocking comment addressed).

jordan: pushed lint fix and rebased on main.

maya: will run perf in ~8m and then proceed with canary. if perf looks fine i'll flip the rollout and monitor for 20m. pinging eng-oncall for extra eyes during rollout.

sasha: perf numbers look stable on staging. p95 latency +2% within noise. nothing alarming.

maya: merging now, canary started. monitoring dashboards: https://console.redwood/rollouts/4129

devops-bot: Canary metrics (first 10m): errors 0, tail latency stable.

jordan: thanks everyone — will follow up with a short postmortem if anything odd shows up, otherwise i'll tag this as merged in the changelog. :tada:
